method: Parquet footers and filesystem metadata only for table inventories; small provenance JSON and run logs for provenance. No table data pages or large raw inputs are scanned.
count_unit: Stored rows across derived tables; not unique documents.

files.grain: One work_id with ordered, deduplicated author IDs and team_size.
One work with the ISO2 countries of its authors' institutions: the sorted distinct set, the per-country author counts, and the first and last author's own countries.
One paper_id with a legacy team_size value.
files.note: The current project has no producer for this legacy file. Native team-size validation uses the reproducible paper_author.parquet output, whose team_size counts distinct authors rather than affiliation rows.

files.grain: One journal pair per cohort year.
One work_id with ordered, deduplicated author IDs and team_size.
One publication with journal-pair atypicality scores; 1990-2000 partition only, no merged corpus-wide file yet.
One journal pair per cohort year; 1990-2000 partition only.
One citation window (3, 5, 10, or all) with paired comparison statistics.
One grant cohort year with aggregate metrics.
One utility patent with the ISO2 countries of the inventor addresses printed on the grant, the per-country inventor counts, and the assignee countries.
One distinct (citing_id, cited_id, type) reference; grant_id identifies the granted cited endpoint.
files.note: Granted and application references may share a grant_id. Deduplicate (citing_id, grant_id) when unique patent edges are required; cited_id preserves the original cited identifier.

files.grain: One CPC-subclass pair per cohort year.
One paper-patent linkage pair per citing year with paper-side counts.
One paper-patent linkage pair per citing year with patent-side counts.
One decision cohort year with aggregate metrics.

excluded_datasets.reason: Sharded reference intermediate, not a final top-level table.

exclusions_note: Explicit canonical top-level outputs only. Old vintages, backups, dated z-score partitions and sharded reference intermediates are excluded. The legacy paper_team_size table remains listed and labeled.

paper_z_score_provenance.note: Coverage is explicitly recorded in the provenance file; the bare output filename does not imply coverage beginning in 1900.
paper_z_score_provenance.vintage: post-MAG-alignment fix (is_journal-only mapping) and post two-pass rewrite

ppp_provenance.note: Pair counts describe linkage records, not trend rows. Saved outputs embedded in the producing notebook may be stale; provenance below requires a job log matching both current output row counts.
